name: Weapons (武器)
units: a weapon is drawn in the units of its design sheet (pixels of the scan); its weapon.json gives the metres per unit and the sheet pixel the origin sits on
notes: Colours are linear RGB.  In weapon data a colour input may name a palette entry instead of giving RGB.
A finish is a palette colour with its roughness, metallicness and (for a light) emission strength; every part names the finish it is made of.

The studio is the light a design sheet is drawn under: a dim world and the soft boxes each weapon's studio fit places before it.  The paper is no part of it: a shot renders on transparent film laid on the paper (its look's backdrop), so the paper never lights the weapon.

WPN.Housing.note: dark painted alloy of the housing, shaft and fittings

WPN.Polymer.note: light grey polymer of the grips, pads and lever

WPN.Blackened.note: blackened steel of the blade's flat

WPN.Steel.note: polished steel of the blade's grind

WPN.Brushed.note: spun metal of the rotor face

WPN.Enamel.note: white enamel of the rotor ring, hub and grip band
